text:
Framework 5.0 is out, and it's the fastest release so far. We dropped support for Node 16 so the framework can use a newer runtime, and the new router runs 2.3x faster than the old one, so apps should feel snappier.

Upgrading means dealing with 7 breaking changes. We've included a codemod that handles most of that work: run it, then review the changes it makes.

If you're starting a new product or updating an existing project, 5.0 is ready to install today.
